Rally's alternate tvOS playback path uses VideoLAN VLCKit from the official
VideoLAN repository at revision 2e0868f5ed40fe59cd92f377645fdcc260c6e759.
VLCKit is licensed under LGPL 2.1 or later. Its license text is included in
VLCKit-LGPL.txt. Exact source: https://github.com/videolan/vlckit/tree/2e0868f5ed40fe59cd92f377645fdcc260c6e759

The bundled XCFramework is the upstream VideoLAN build downloaded through the
official Swift Package manifest. Rally does not modify VLCKit. Check the exact
license files of included VLC modules and codecs before distributing a build.
